Examples.Title:
Cancel an active ChatKit session and return its most recent metadata.

Cancelling prevents new requests from using the issued client secret.
Examples.Code:
### Cancel an active ChatKit session and return its most recent metadata.

Cancelling prevents new requests from using the issued client secret.
# @name CancelChatSessionMethod
POST {{host}}/chatkit/sessions/{{session_id}}/cancel
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Success
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Creates an edited or extended image given one or more source images and a prompt. This endpoint supports GPT Image models (`gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1-mini`, and `chatgpt-image-latest`) and `dall-e-2`.
Examples.Description:
You can call this endpoint with either:

- `multipart/form-data`: use binary uploads via `image` (and optional `mask`).
- `application/json`: use `images` (and optional `mask`) as references with either `image_url` or `file_id`.

Note that JSON requests use `images` (array) instead of the multipart `image` field.
Examples.Code:
### Creates an edited or extended image given one or more source images and a prompt. This endpoint supports GPT Image models (`gpt-image-1.5`, `gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1-mini`, and `chatgpt-image-latest`) and `dall-e-2`.
# @name createImageEdit
POST {{host}}/images/edits
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=AutoSDKBoundary
Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="image"; filename="image.bin"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

< ./image.bin
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="prompt"

A cute baby sea otter wearing a beret
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="mask"; filename="mask.bin"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

< ./mask.bin
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="background"

transparent
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="model"

gpt-image-1.5
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="n"

1
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="size"

1024x1024
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="response_format"

url
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="output_format"

png
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="output_compression"

100
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="user"

user-1234
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="input_fidelity"

string
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="stream"

false
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="partial_images"

string
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="quality"

high
--AutoSDKBoundary--
